text:
emma: Heads-up  opened a docs PR to unify our error reference for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit failures. Goal: one short troubleshooting playbook + migration notes, SDK snippets (js/py/go), and an ops checklist. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478. Who can review snippets?

john: Ill take a pass on the Go and Python examples. Quick Go sketch for respecting Retry-After:```go
if res.StatusCode == 429 {
  ra := res.Header.Get("Retry-After")
  wait := time.Second
  if ra != "" {
    if secs, err := strconv.Atoi(ra); err == nil { wait = time.Duration(secs) * time.Second }
  }
  time.Sleep(wait + time.Duration(rand.Intn(300))*time.Millisecond)
}
```

priya: I'll add the SDK patterns. Suggest showing three tiers: naive (single retry), robust (exp backoff + jitter + idempotency key), and ultra (circuit-breaker + queueing). Should we also include a short test harness for mocking 429 storms?

kai: Yes please. I'll add a tiny harness script that spins up a mock endpoint and asserts retry behavior. Also adding a note: for UI endpoints prefer fail-fast and show cached/degraded UX rather than loop retries.

zheng: From infra side: call out that some customers private proxies strip Retry-After; include an nginx snippet to preserve it in proxies:```nginx
proxy_pass_header Retry-After;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
```
And add mitigation: use idempotency keys + dedupe in the client so retries don't amplify load.

emma: Good. Also include a small table mapping a handful of model families -> how they surface context limit vs truncation. Example row: "mistral-3": truncates and returns 200 with truncation_notice header; "gptx-4": returns 413 on reject. I'll add the canonical phrasing to avoid confusion.

john: Another runtime tip: if Retry-After missing, prefer an adaptive base backoff (start 250ms) and double, cap at 8s. Surface a trace tag like `retry.source=client` and `retry.storm=true` so SRE can filter spikes.

priya: For SDK snippets I'll include an idempotency-key example and a small request-dedupe table for common languages. Example JS pattern:`const id = uuid(); client.request(..., { idempotencyKey: id })` and keep retries idempotent.

kai: UX paragraph drafted: tradeoffs between aggressive retries (may recover) vs deterministic degrade (better for interactive apps). I'll add recommended thresholds per product type.

ci-bot: running checks: docs-lint, link-check, spellcheck.

emma: heads-up link-check flagged /internal/playbooks/rate-limit-handbook as missing. That path used to exist; I moved content to /errors/rate-limits. I'll update references in the draft.

zheng: Also can we add a short note on context-limited generation: recommend early token trimming (system prompts + template inflation) and KV cache reuse to avoid hitting limits repeatedly.

john: Added a small go test illustrating a mocked 429 with missing Retry-After to the examples repo. Test command: `go test ./examples/retries`.

priya: pushed SDK commits and a python snippet showing backoff with requests and tenacity:```py
from tenacity import retry, wait_exponential, stop_after_attempt
@retry(wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=0.25, max=8), stop=stop_after_attempt(5))
def call_api():
  ...
```

emma: Nice. One more: include a migration section called "From fixed-sleeps to token-aware retry" that explains why fixed 3x waits cause thundering and how to move to Retry-After-based and model-aware fallbacks.

kai: I'll also include a short note about fallback routing: recommend configuring automatic downgrade to a smaller compatible variant for non-critical paths. Show policy example: `fallback: [{from: gptx-4, to: gptx-4-compact, max_latency_increase: 30%}]`.

ci-bot: link-check failed: discovered internal link to /internal/playbooks/rate-limit-handbook (404).

emma: Fixed all internal refs in PR, updated the playbook path to /errors/rate-limits, adjusted anchors. Re-ran CI.

ci-bot: docs-lint, link-check, spellcheck passed. All checks green. \u2705

emma: Final owners before merge: john (examples/tests), priya (SDK snippets + README), zheng (nginx + infra notes), kai (UX + fallback policy), me (merge + changelog). Please do final review; planning to merge this afternoon.

priya: LGTM, tests passing locally.

john: minor nit in go snippet fixed.

zheng: infra checklist added.

ci-bot: PR merged by emma  commit 7b2c4f9. Release note queued: "docs: consolidated rate-limit and context-limit playbook; added SDK retries + fallback examples."
